breville-smart-oven-air-fryer-pro-bov900: Main-oven stand-in with even cooking, though cleaning after greasy air frying is the big gripe.
breville-smart-oven-pro-bov845: Quick preheat and even heating that replaces the big oven; many report the convection fan failing.
breville-sous-chef-16-pro-bfp800: Sturdy and powerful, still going after years of regular use and good at slicing.
breville-super-q-bbl920: Quieter than a Vitamix, with velvety smoothies; two note the very tight lid is hard to remove.
cosori-dual-blaze-6-8-qt: Two heating elements cook evenly without much shaking; a smaller group report the nonstick wearing.
cosori-pro-le-5-qt: Compact, quick and easy to clean, though the basket is small for bigger batches.
cosori-turboblaze-6-qt: Quick, fairly quiet and easy to clean; food cooks fast and hot, so standard times need trimming.
instant-pot-duo: No-fuss pressure cooker that many still use after eight to ten years; sealing rings hold smells.
instant-pot-duo-crisp: Pressure cooker and air fryer lid in one pot, but the air fryer is small and awkward to clean.
instant-pot-pro: Handled inner pot and better sauté than older models; a good number report units stuck in preheat.
instant-pot-pro-crisp: Air fryer lid crisps whole chicken skin for one or two; small capacity and uneven heat limit it.
instant-vortex-6-qt: Simple and reliable, with several using it daily for years; the main gripe is a burnt plastic smell.
instant-vortex-plus-6-qt: Crisps fries, nuggets and burgers well, though a plastic smell on first use is the main complaint.
kitchenaid-heavy-duty-5-2-l-bowl-lift-st: Stronger than a tilt-head, with little bouncing on dough; a noticeable group report new units dying.
ninja-air-fryer-af101: Simple, sturdy and good value for one or two people; grease builds up around the element.
ninja-crispi-fn101: Glass bowls go in the dishwasher and double as storage, but air frying is weaker for some.
ninja-crispi-pro-as101: Glass containers let food be watched and replaced the oven for many; a few found food undercooked.
ninja-flip-toaster-oven-sp151: Flips up out of the way and does toast, air frying and pizza; cleaning round elements is the gripe.
ninja-foodi-digital-air-fry-oven-sp101: Heats fast and flips up against the wall to save space; grease bakes onto elements and trays.
ninja-foodi-flexbasket-dz071: One big drawer or a removable divider for two zones that finish together, and it washes up quickly.
ninja-foodi-max-dual-zone-smart-cook-af4: Dual baskets, sync finish and a meat probe; a couple report it failing early.
philips-airfryer-4000-series-stacked-dua: Compact stacked design with an inside light and viewing windows that avoid opening the baskets.
philips-airfryer-5000-series-dual-basket: Steam option keeps vegetables, chicken and fries moist; one owner never uses the steamer.
typhur-dome: Easy-to-clean ceramic basket and quiet running; the low height can leave food near the top element.
typhur-dome-2: Cooks lots of food without flipping across a wide tray; large footprint, and shallow for tall items.
vitamix-5200: Tough, simple blender that often lasts a decade or more; loud, and a few newer units felt cheaper.
vitamix-5300: Long-lasting workhorse, often bought refurbished; noisy, and awkward for small batches.
vitamix-alta-pro: Smoothie, soup and self-clean presets; some report a burning plastic smell, and it can be loud.
vitamix-ascent-a2500: Easy presets and a solid feel, but many report stalled blends or air pockets in small batches.
vitamix-ascent-a3500: Powerful with easy presets; container detection fails with attachments and some units show errors.
vitamix-ascent-x2: Physical knob and switches alongside the presets; a few dislike the container detection.
vitamix-explorian-e310: Good value, with a narrow container for small batches; loud, and some struggled with thick blends.
vitamix-professional-series-750: Powerful and well built, often running ten years; some units failed at the start switch or motor.
vitamix-venturist-v1200: Good-value model with a timer and app presets; self-detect containers sometimes go unrecognised.
